title: game Crash without error, when deleting the current selected TreeItem when is not the last of is sibling.
body:
### Tested versions

encountered in Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.official.49a5bc7b6

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7652) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-11900F @ 2.50GHz (16 threads)

### Issue description

when freeing a treeItem that have a index less that is parent child_count() - 1.
the godot debugging instance crash without warning and error message.

### Steps to reproduce

create a scene with a Tree.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a006f362-ae22-42b7-aabf-a01a4a079c3c)

add this internal script to the tree and connect his signal.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/16706751-aa8c-44b2-895f-12deb8dcf407)

launch the scene and click on "aaa" or "bbb" and watch the game freeze and crash.

if you click on "ccc" and "bbb" and "aaa" in this order the game will not crash.
same with clicking on the root.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[tree-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20890252/tree-bug.zip)
